## Scientific

## Live

- [Agora-Conf](https://agora.artifact-network.org). Conference companion built on Indico: programme, slide annotation. Used at the AISSAI Accelerator Hackathon 2026.
- [arXiv Enhancer](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/arxiv-enhancer/). Browser extension for arXiv, Firefox and Chrome.
- [ag-* libraries](software.qmd). Open-source Python libraries for LLM pipelines, on PyPI.

## Closed

| Project | What it was | Period |
|---|---|---|
| GrantYou | Alerts on EU and national funding calls for researchers | May to October 2026 |
| Mawlaia platform | Hosted API and dashboard for the ag-* libraries. Code: [ag-platform](https://github.com/aghribi/ag-platform) | August to October 2026 |
| Agora-Marketplace | Marketplace between conference organisers and companies. Never opened to the public | May to October 2026 |
| Mermaid Diagrams for Google Docs and Confluence | Editor add-ons rendering Mermaid diagrams. Built, not released | August 2026 |
